children: Hillman Solutions entered into an amendment to its term loan credit agreement to add $200 million of senior secured term loans. The loans, which mature on July 22, 2033, are priced at the borrower’s option at SOFR plus 2.00% or ABR plus 1.00% and include customary covenants without financial maintenance tests. Proceeds, together with cash and revolver borrowings, funded a portion of the Kanebridge acquisition and related fees. The loans are guaranteed by certain subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets of the borrower and guarantors.
: Senior secured term loan amendment adding $200 million of term loans
: Jefferies Finance, as Administrative Agent, and participating lenders
: Finance Kanebridge acquisition and related costs
